blinding_guess.why: All ten FFmpeg symbols are called with signatures that exist in the libavcodec/libswscale generation shipped for kinetic (libavcodec major > 52 path compiled), so nothing is visibly missing; but avpicture_get_size, avpicture_layout and avcodec_decode_video2 are the deprecated pre-3.x API, and the code fixes AVCodecContext.pix_fmt to AV_PIX_FMT_YUV422P then checks the decoder's actual pix_fmt size against a YUV422P-sized buffer, which would reject cameras whose MJPEG decodes to a 4:2:0 format. Whether either counts as a defect against the paired library cannot be told from this snapshot alone.
